prompt:
Create one high-quality landscape educational information graphic for railway maintenance engineers explaining the actual TOV1050 Analyzer repository. All explanatory visible copy must use Traditional Chinese, retain named English technical identifiers exactly. Flat crisp editorial engineering illustration, white/cool #f6f8fb background, #263348 dark ink, #2b63c9 blue, #256f62 teal, amber only for caveats, red only failures. Noto Sans TC-like legible type, large headings and generous margins. Clear directed arrows, no decorative gradients, no fake logos, no ornamental cards, no microscopic text. Main graphic should dominate, concise labels arranged in reading order. The image is explanatory, not certification. Render only the specified facts and labels, no invented metrics. Keep typography accurate; no simplified Chinese. 
Title: 「線耗計算邏輯」
A wire cross-section explanatory diagram with a circular upper remaining segment and lower worn circular cap. Draw remaining vertical thickness r from original top to flat wear plane (NOT radius), R as original radius. Label r：平均剩餘厚度 and R = 6.6 mm. Beside show flow 量測 wear_min → TL 彙整 → 平均／標準差 → 截面換算. Equations exact: θ = acos((r − R) / R); A = θR² − R sin(θ)(r − R); 線耗率 = clamp(A / 120 × 100, 0, 100) %. Label 120 mm²：程式名義截面積, not pi R². Amber box 現行特殊值：r = 0 回傳 0%; 這是程式行為，非零厚度的物理解釋. Footer: 既有線材常數，TOV1050 適用性待核定.
